nodes.statement: check_alt_fragment = true
nodes.type_context:
Mathlib
def alt (n : Nat) : Nat := if n % 2 = 0 then 1 else 2

def check_alt_fragment : Bool := decide (
  ((Finset.range 200).filter (fun n => alt (n + 1) >= alt n)).card = 100 ∧
  ((Finset.range 200).filter (fun n => alt (n + 1) <= alt n)).card = 100 ∧
  ((Finset.range 200).filter (fun n => alt (n + 1) = alt n)).card = 0
)
nodes.claim: Kernel checking establishes that for the explicit alternating sequence alt n = 1 when n is even and 2 when n is odd, among indices n < 200 exactly 100 satisfy alt (n+1) ≥ alt n, exactly 100 satisfy alt (n+1) ≤ alt n, and none satisfy alt (n+1) = alt n; this is only the stated finite fragment and does not establish any canonical prime-gap clause.
